description:
Generate placeholder text: classic Lorem ipsum, readable English filler, or Arabic filler. Choose paragraphs (max 100), sentences (max 500) or words (max 10000); optionally start with the classic opener and wrap paragraphs in

tags. Give a seed for repeatable output (the same seed gives the same text). Writes a .txt/.html file instead when "output" is given. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/lorem-gen/

count.description: How many paragraphs / sentences / words (clamped to the unit limit).

opener.description: Start with the classic opening line ("Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet…", "The quick brown fox…", or the Arabic one). Default true.

output.description: Optional: write the text to this file path (or folder ending in "/") instead of returning it.

style.description: Word list: lorem (Latin), english, or arabic.

name: text_lorem
title: Lorem ipsum generator
